name: 盒马
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=盒马
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = acs.m.taobao.com, acs-m.freshippo.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.hippotown\.tabbar\.info/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.sg\.querysinglescene/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.render\.querysinglepage/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.fc\.recommend\.feedscommondservice/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.crm\.platform\.ma\.recommend/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.mimir\.recommend\.after\.purchase\.activity/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/acs(\.|-)m\.(taobao|freshippo)\.com\/gw\/mtop\.wdk\.render\.query(?>indexpage|mypage|tabfeedstream)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/freshippo.js") with enable=${hema_enable}, tag="盒马", timeout=60, requires_body=true
